evidence.quote: Founded in Faenza in 1985, the company has grown to To become an international partner in the fields of nuclear medicine, radiopharmacy, cancer radiation therapy, and the pharmaceutical industry. || Every day, in hospitals, research centers, and manufacturing facilities around the world, professionals are working to improve health and quality of life.
